method: Built-in image_gen; én generering pr. motiv. SVG og stjernehimmel fremstilles i kode ifølge manifestet.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Game art asset for a serious, elegant celestial fantasy RPG whose world map is a star atlas of constellations in a midnight indigo and soft violet cosmos. The game itself draws the starry map, node frames, connection lines, glow and all interface, so the image contains only what is described. Shared look: finely crafted, jewel-like fantasy miniature quality; rich, saturated jewel tones set against deep indigo-blue shadows; a soft warm key light from the upper left balanced by a cool blue-violet starlight fill from the right; clear value contrast and a strong, instantly readable silhouette; grounded medieval fantasy materials such as wood, bark, stone, copper, iron, leather and fur with convincing texture. Mood: airy, magical and restrained; serious and neutral, never cute, comic or caricatured, no exaggerated expressions, no gore. No text, letters, numbers, runes, inscriptions, heraldry, logos, signatures or watermarks anywhere, including on blades, shields and rims. No frame, border, backing plate, panel, button, bar or other interface element, and no glowing outline, outer glow, halo, lens flare or vignette around the subject. No smoke, haze, heat shimmer, drifting sparks or floating particles.
Asset type: node icon for a talent-tree map tile. Rendering: a finely painted, richly detailed fantasy miniature in the manner of a premium RPG item icon, with crisp edges and painterly texture, seen in a slight three-quarter view from above. Composition: one subject, centered, with generous empty space on all sides and nothing touching or crossing the edges. Background: fully transparent, with no scenery, sky, stars, sparkles, smoke or cast shadow beyond the subject's own small base. The subject must stay recognizable as a flat dark silhouette and at 56 px on a near-black indigo tile.
Subject: A broad, mature oak tree with a thick gnarled trunk and a full, rounded crown of lobed leaves, standing on a small grassy mound with visible roots.
Output composition: square image. Maintain about 12% transparent margin on every side.
